title: Towards Agentic Proof Harness Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.23241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formal verification of real-world projects requires substantial manual effort, from specifying correctness properties to constructing the infrastructure needed to check them. We envision verification agents that assist developers throughout this process. Among the many tasks involved, one stands out as both foundational and amenable to automation: proof-harness engineering. A proof harness defines an isolated verification environment for a program unit, such as a function or module, by providing symbolic inputs, initialization code, and models of its dependencies. Today, proof-harness engineering remains largely a manual task performed by verification engineers. To explore the potential of coding agents for this task, we propose an agentic proof-harness engineer that automatically constructs verifier-ready harnesses from a software project and a designated verification target. translated_title: 迈向智能体化的证明测试桩工程
translated_abstract: 对真实世界项目进行形式化验证需要大量人工投入，从指定正确性属性到构建检查这些属性所需的基础设施。我们设想由验证智能体在整个过程中协助开发者。在涉及的众多任务中，有一项任务既具有基础性又适合自动化：证明测试桩工程。证明测试桩通过提供符号化输入、初始化代码以及其依赖项的模型，为一个程序单元（如函数或模块）定义一个隔离的验证环境。如今，证明测试桩工程在很大程度上仍是由验证工程师手动完成的任务。为探索编程智能体在此任务中的潜力，我们提出了一种智能体化的证明测试桩工程器，它能够根据一个软件项目和指定的验证目标自动构建可供验证器直接使用的测试桩。我们将该智能体与形式化的可靠性和精度保障相结合……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种智能体化的证明测试桩工程器，能够根据软件项目和指定的验证目标自动构建可供验证器使用的证明测试桩，从而大幅减少形式化验证中的人工工作量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an agentic proof-harness engineer that automatically constructs verifier-ready proof harnesses from a software project and a designated verification target, substantially reducing the manual effort required for formal verification.
